description: This file contains implementation of CBC mode encryption and decryption functions for AES, part of the BoringSSL cryptography library, including functions CRYPTO_cbc128_encrypt and CRYPTO_cbc128_decrypt.

methods.name: CRYPTO_cbc128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption on input data.

methods.name: CRYPTO_cbc128_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode decryption on input data.
